description: This file defines a set of API endpoints for analyzing, retrieving, and managing analysis data related to resumes and job matching. It uses FastAPI to create HTTP routes that handle analysis status checks, result retrieval, suggestion acknowledgment, analysis cancellation, and listing user analyses.

methods.name: get_analysis_status( analysis_id: UUID = Path(..., alias="id"), repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends(), )
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a specific analysis by its UUID.

methods.name: get_analysis_results( analysis_id: UUID = Path(..., alias="id"), analysis_repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends(), findings_repo: FindingRepository = Depends(), suggestions_repo: SuggestionRepository = Depends(), )
methods.description: Fetches the complete results, including findings and suggestions, for a completed analysis.

methods.name: acknowledge_suggestion( analysis_id: UUID = Path(..., alias="id"), suggestion_id: int = Body(..., embed=True), )
methods.description: Acknowledges a specific suggestion related to an analysis (no actual update in current implementation).

methods.name: cancel_analysis( analysis_id: UUID = Path(..., alias="id"), repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends(), )
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing analysis by updating its status to 'cancelled'.

methods.name: get_user_analyses( user_id: UUID = Path(..., alias="userId"), repo: AnalysisRepository = Depends(), )
methods.description: Retrieves all analyses associated with a specific user.
